name: StartDeepScan
transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork after LLD12 proof validation to revalidate preview and enqueue/coalesce DEEP_SCAN job
guards: LLD12 deliberate proof valid, unexpired, single-use and bound to COMMUNICATION_DEEP_SCAN/source_scope/revision/preview fingerprint
receipt_order: replay -> validate/consume deliberate proof + revalidate preview -> insert command_receipt -> durable job/scope -> audit/results -> commit
revision_effects: no forward high-water change at enqueue
